#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-scoped helper: locate and preview European economic performance data files
in the current workspace directory so the data storytelling report can be built
against the actual schema/figures present."""
import os

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
print("WORKSPACE:", BASE)
found_any = False
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(BASE):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".") and d != "__pycache__"]
    for f in sorted(files):
        p = os.path.join(root, f)
        rel = os.path.relpath(p, BASE)
        size = os.path.getsize(p)
        print("=" * 90)
        print(f"FILE: {rel}   (size={size} bytes)")

            print(f"  (unreadable as UTF-8 text: {exc})")
            continue
        lines = text.splitlines()
        print(f"LINES: {len(lines)}")
        for i, line in enumerate(lines[:80], start=1):
            print(f"{i:>6} | {line}")
        if len(lines) > 80:
            print(f"  ... [{len(lines) - 80} more lines omitted]")

import os

for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
    # Skip obvious non-data dirs like .git / __pycache__
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in (".git", "__pycache__", ".codex", ".venv", "venv")]
    depth = root.count(os.sep)
    indent = "  " * depth
    print(f"{indent}{root or '.'}/")
    for f in sorted(files):
        full = os.path.join(root, f)
        try:
            size = os.path.getsize(full)
        except OSError:
            size = -1
        print(f"{indent}  {f}  ({size} bytes)")
